tonight.headline: Coker is cleared; the defence is still on bye
body: Bad news first: nine hours after the morning brief your only defence is still the Vikings, on bye, at 0.0 — the Patriots add has not been made. The Patriots are still a free agent at 7.7 at 15:50; add them and drop the Vikings.

Good news on the rest: Coker practised in full on Wednesday and ESPN has cleared his tag, so the flex no longer needs a fallback. Likely was listed with a foot issue but practised fully; Kamara was limited with his back and stays on the bench. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 119.4 against Bok-aneers' 89.6 — they are starting Gibbs and Chase Brown, both on bye.

case.label: Why still today
case.body: A free agent goes to whoever clicks first. Since the morning, Panda Attack added a kicker (Zvada) at 20:40 UTC — managers are active. Jets 7.4 and Giants 7.1 are the free fallbacks; the Jaguars are on waivers until Thursday 01:00 and project 6.9.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The Patriots added by someone else before you: take the Jets, same drop. A Coker setback on Thursday's or Friday's report would bring Kamara back as the flex fallback.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Free agent now · no claim needed · must be done before Sun 11:00 Mexico City (Patriots kickoff), sooner is safer
doFirst.title: Add the Patriots' defence; drop the Vikings'
doFirst.subtitle: Still not done since this morning. The Patriots are free, the best defence on your wire, and Minnesota are on bye.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Vikings D/ST is your only defence and Minnesota are off in Week 6: 0.0 in a slot the wire fills for 7-8. Still unfixed at the 21:50 UTC snapshot.

case.label: The pick
case.body: Patriots 7.7, Jets 7.4, Giants 7.1 among free agents in this league's projection. FantasyPros ranked New England 2nd this week: Geno Smith has taken at least three sacks in each of his last four games (13 Oct). Wednesday's Jets report: Adonai Mitchell did not practise after a finger procedure, Kenyon Sadiq limited in concussion protocol (NewYorkJets.com, 14 Oct) — a thinner Jets passing game.

case.label: The drop
case.body: The Vikings are 79% rostered, so this disagrees with the market on the record: a defence on bye scores nothing, defences are streamed by policy, and every skill player on the bench is either exposure-protected (Kamara, Gordon) or back in Week 7 (Jefferson, Addison).

case.label: The other side
case.body: The same game is the Jets defence's best case too, and New England's Christian Gonzalez was limited Wednesday with two corners absent (Yahoo, 14 Oct). The 0.3 gap to the Jets is a coin flip, so the projection decides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Patriots score less in Week 6 than the Jets or the Giants defences, the two free alternatives today (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The Ravens claim did not land
whatWentWrong.lead: Bok-aneers took Baltimore at 07:54 UTC and Footballers the Chiefs. You are still 2nd in the order, which suggests your claim was never placed.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Waivers process in order and every team that won a claim fell to the bottom (Bok-aneers 10th, Footballers 9th, Talla Metralla 8th). AVIATO sit 2nd, unchanged — a team ahead of Bok-aneers that had claimed the Ravens would have got them. ESPN does not show failed claims, so this is an inference.

case.label: The cost
case.body: About half a point: Ravens 8.2 against the Patriots 7.7 now available free. The real cost would be letting the bye stand — that is the card above.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: If the claim was placed and lost to a reordering, the lesson is different: name a free-agent fallback on every claim card. This brief now does.
